correctness.rationale: Conjugating the four allowed signed-permutation actions by the diagonal coordinate map gives independent signs on \(m=(a+b)/2\) and \(d=(a-b)/2\). The identity \(|m|+|d|=\max\{|a|,|b|\}\) bounds each scalar increment. Greedy opposite-sign choices keep both scalar partial sums in \([-1,1]\). Convexity of the \(\ell_q\) norm composed with \((M,D)\mapsto(M+D,M-D)\) bounds the whole square by its vertex value \(2\). The two-vector witness \((1,1),(1,-1)\) forces a second prefix of norm \(2\) for every \(q\). All quantifiers, endpoints \(q=1\) and \(q=\infty\), and online dependence were checked explicitly.
